news.title: Well-travelled Brazil fans in Singapore relish chance to watch football stars on ‘home’ turf
news.lede: Diego Romero (far left) with Brazilian legend and former captain Dunga during a trip to watch the national team at the 2022 World Cup. Singapore-based Brazilian fan Henrique (right) at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar. PHOTOS: COURTESY OF DIEGO ROMERO, COURTESY OF HENRIQUE RODRIGUES QUEIROZ. SINGAPORE – Ask Brazil fan Diego Romero how much he has spent chasing his national team around the world and he can give only a vague estimate.

news.title: Scott McTominay opens up on heart scare and reveals shock treatment before World Cup match
news.lede: Scott McTominay has explained how his heart scare struck on the eve of Scotland's World Cup campaign. It was first revealed in September that McTominay had been diagnosed with a mild benign arrhythmia , an irregular heart rhythm. It is considered non-serious but required surgery and saw him sidelined for Napoli and Scotland. The midfielder first noticed the symptoms a few days before Scotland's first match at this summer's World Cup, against Haiti.

news.title: World Cup trophy used by Messi in viral Instagram photo sells for $525,000
news.lede: The World Cup replica trophy held by Lionel Messi after Argentina's historic win over France at the 2022 tournament in Qatar sold for a staggering price. (Richmond Auctions via SWNS). A replica World Cup trophy used by Lionel Messi in an Instagram post that became the most-liked photo in the world has sold for a whopping £390,000 ($525,000). Argentina lifted the real solid gold trophy after squeezing past France on penalties during its historic campaign at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.

news.title: Scott McTominay: Scotland midfielder had heart 'shocked' two days before World Cup opener against Haiti
news.lede: Scott McTominay has revealed he needed to have his heart “shocked” two days before Scotland's World Cup opener against Haiti. The Napoli midfielder underwent a cardiac ablation procedure in Manchester in September to treat a mild, benign heart arrhythmia that first came to light after the Scots arrived in the United States in early June and then continued to affect him in August while back in Italy playing for his club. At the time, the Scotland camp, clearly keen to keep McTominay's situation under wraps, said the 29-year-old had missed training in the lead-up to the World Cup due to a stomach complaint.
